name: Kale Chips
steps: Heat oven to 150°C. Strip kale leaves from their tough center stems and tear into broad pieces; they shrink while baking.
Wash and dry the leaves completely in a spinner or towels. Massage olive oil into every leaf with your fingers; use only a thin coating.
Spread in a single layer on two trays. Bake 12–15 minutes, rotating trays halfway, until edges are crisp but not brown.
Cool for 3 minutes, then toss with salt and paprika. Serve immediately; leaving the chips uncovered in humidity softens them.
tips: Wet leaves steam instead of crisping, so drying is the most important step.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
